parsed.reason: The text is wrong on several counts: it gives a clock time "3:00" for the all-day Jour de congé, which should carry no time; it omits Léa's natation entirely (10:00-11:00 AM at Piscine Main); and it calls the day open with "un peu de répit" (breathing room), which the facts do not support since a timed event exists. It also adds an unrequested comment about the day. The French is also not idiomatic ("Tomorrow's" fragment mixed in, and "Mon, Oct 26" reads like a system label), so it fails the native speaker and friend tone checks as well.
